title: Build or Adopt? Custom-Built vs. General-Purpose LLM Agent Harnesses for Automotive GUI Testing
title_zh: 构建还是采用？汽车GUI测试中定制构建与通用LLM智能体框架的对比

paragraphs.en: As general-purpose LLM agent harnesses mature, organizations must decide whether to continue developing in-house systems or adopt existing alternatives. We study this decision at Volvo Group for GUI testing of Android-based in-vehicle infotainment (IVI) systems. We compare a production, custom-built harness with two general-purpose harnesses, Claude Code and OpenCode, keeping the tools, accessed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and the models the same. We evaluate the harnesses with up to four models on Volvo’s IVI test cases and on open-ended tasks in public apps (Google Maps, Booking.com), and interview ten practitioners: developers, the product owner, and testers. On Volvo’s stepwise IVI tests, general-purpose harnesses match the custom-built harness in success but vary more across runs. Their inference cost per task is 2.6–10.7 times higher, yet the engineering effort they save outweighs this: for a nightly IVI regression suite, total monthly cost, including engineering effort and inference, is 3–66% lower. On open-ended public-app tasks, they succeed more often, mainly because they recover better from incorrect actions. Interviews suggest that external advances can turn an in-house harness into technical debt even without deterioration. Adopting a general-purpose harness shifts maintenance from the agent loop to tools and instructions, but gives teams less control over what the model receives. Regardless of the harness, testers want to inspect the agent’s actions and ensure that it follows the prescribed test scenario.
paragraphs.zh: 随着通用型 LLM 智能体框架日趋成熟，各组织必须决定是继续开发自研系统，还是采用现有的替代方案。 我们以沃尔沃集团基于 Android 的车载信息娱乐（IVI）系统的 GUI 测试为对象，研究这一决策。 我们将一个生产环境中的自研框架与两个通用框架 Claude Code 和 OpenCode 进行比较，保持通过模型上下文协议（MCP）访问的工具和所使用的模型一致。 我们在沃尔沃的 IVI 测试用例以及公开应用（Google Maps、Booking.com）中的开放式任务上，用最多四个模型评估这些框架，并访谈了十位从业者：开发人员、产品负责人和测试人员。 在沃尔沃的分步式 IVI 测试上，通用框架的成功率与自研框架相当，但不同运行之间的波动更大。 它们每个任务的推理成本高出 2.6–10.7 倍，但所节省的工程投入足以抵消这一成本：对于每夜运行的 IVI 回归测试套件，包含工程投入和推理在内的每月总成本降低了 3–66%。 在公开应用的开放式任务上，通用框架的成功率更高，主要原因是它们能更好地从错误操作中恢复。 访谈表明，即使自研框架本身没有退化，外部的技术进步也可能使其沦为技术债务。 采用通用框架将维护工作从智能体循环转移到工具和指令上，但团队对模型所接收内容的控制力也随之减弱。 无论使用哪种框架，测试人员都希望能够检查智能体的操作，并确保其遵循规定的测试场景。

paragraphs.en: Graphical user interface (GUI) testing of Android-based in-vehicle infotainment (IVI) systems is labor-intensive. These systems are stateful, depend on the state of the vehicle, and change with every software release; scripted tests break whenever the layout changes [ 1 ] , and manual testing does not keep pace. Large language model (LLM) agents address this by executing natural-language test intents directly on the device, interpreting the screen rather than relying on static identifiers. When LLM agents first emerged, no capable general-purpose harness , i.e., the software that turns a foundation model into an agent, existed, forcing organizations like Volvo to build their own, as for automotive software release analytics [ 2 ] . These in-house systems are custom-built , relying on code to strictly define the agent’s control loop, prompt construction, and subagent routing.
paragraphs.zh: 基于安卓的车载信息娱乐（IVI）系统的图形用户界面（GUI）测试非常耗费人力。 这些系统是有状态的，依赖于车辆的状态，并且随着每次软件发布而变化；每当布局发生变化时，脚本化测试就会失效 [1]，而人工测试跟不上节奏。 大语言模型（LLM）智能体解决了这一问题，它直接在设备上执行自然语言测试意图，通过解读屏幕而非依赖静态标识符来进行操作。 当 LLM 智能体刚出现时，尚不存在一个功能完善的通用型 harness，即把基础模型转化为智能体的软件，这迫使像沃尔沃这样的组织自行构建，例如用于汽车软件发布分析的系统 [2]。 这些自研系统是定制构建的，依赖代码来严格定义智能体的控制循环、提示词构建以及子智能体路由。

paragraphs.en: Research on LLM agents for mobile GUIs has followed the same route. Testing agents such as GPTDroid [ 3 ] and DroidAgent [ 4 ] explore apps or pursue test intents through purpose-built memory and planning, and task-automation agents such as AutoDroid [ 5 ] , AppAgent [ 6 ] , and Mobile-Agent [ 7 ] engineer UI representations, app-specific knowledge, and dedicated planning, decision, and reflection agents. These works evaluate new harness designs on benchmarks; to our knowledge, none compares a custom-built harness with a general-purpose one or examines what maintaining it entails in industrial practice.
paragraphs.zh: 面向移动 GUI 的大语言模型智能体的研究也走了同样的路线。 测试类智能体如 GPTDroid [ 3 ] 和 DroidAgent [ 4 ] 通过专门构建的记忆与规划来探索应用或执行测试意图，而任务自动化类智能体如 AutoDroid [ 5 ]、AppAgent [ 6 ] 和 Mobile-Agent [ 7 ] 则设计了 UI 表示、应用特定知识以及专门的规划、决策和反思智能体。 这些工作在基准测试上评估新的框架设计；据我们所知，尚无工作将自建框架与通用框架进行比较，也没有工作考察在工业实践中维护自建框架需要付出什么代价。

paragraphs.en: Building such a harness is an investment in technical credit [ 8 ] , i.e., a design decision that requires higher initial effort in return for long-term benefits, but its value depends on an ecosystem that changes quickly. New model generations alter the agent’s behavior, new requirements, such as operating several devices in one test, go beyond the original design, and both require revising the harness. Meanwhile, general-purpose harnesses, such as Claude Code [ 9 ] and OpenCode [ 10 ] , have matured. They run a generic agent loop maintained by their vendors and can reach domain-specific tools through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) [ 11 ] , which would shift the in-house workload from maintaining an agent loop to maintaining tools and instructions. Thus, technical credit can turn into technical debt without any decay of the system itself. As a result, organizations with in-house agents face a build-versus-adopt decision. However, it is unknown whether a general-purpose harness can replace a custom-built one in industrial testing, what the move costs in operation, and what it changes for the engineers who maintain the agent and the testers who rely on it.
paragraphs.zh: 构建这样的测试框架是对技术信用 [ 8 ] 的投资，即一种需要较高初始投入以换取长期收益的设计决策，但其价值依赖于一个快速变化的生态系统。 新一代模型会改变智能体的行为，新的需求（例如在同一个测试中操作多台设备）超出了最初的设计范围，这两者都要求修订该测试框架。 与此同时，通用测试框架（如 Claude Code [ 9 ] 和 OpenCode [ 10 ] ）已经成熟。 它们运行由供应商维护的通用智能体循环，并可以通过模型上下文协议（MCP）[ 11 ] 访问领域专用工具，这将使内部维护工作从维护智能体循环转向维护工具和指令。 因此，技术信用可能在没有系统本身退化的情况下转变为技术债务。 结果，拥有内部智能体的组织面临自建还是采用现成方案的抉择。 然而，目前尚不清楚通用测试框架能否在工业测试中取代定制框架、这种迁移在运维上需要多大成本，以及对于维护智能体的工程师和依赖该系统的测试人员而言，它会带来哪些改变。

paragraphs.en: We study this decision at Volvo Group. Our key design choice is to vary only the harness: we keep the tools and device access of Volvo’s production agent, use them in both the in-house custom-built harness and vendor-maintained general-purpose ones, such as Claude Code and OpenCode, which access them through an MCP server, and run all harnesses with the same models. As a result, differences between the setups reflect the harness rather than the tools or the model. We evaluate the setups across four models on 66 tasks derived from Volvo’s IVI test cases and on 56 open-ended tasks from the AMEX dataset [ 12 ] , repeat every run to measure flakiness, and interview ten practitioners: four developers, the product owner, and five testers. We address four research questions (RQs):
paragraphs.zh: 我们在沃尔沃集团（Volvo Group）研究这一决策。 我们的关键设计选择是只改变测试框架：我们保留沃尔沃生产智能体的工具与设备访问权限，既在自研框架中使用它们，也在供应商维护的通用框架（如 Claude Code 和 OpenCode，它们通过 MCP 服务器访问这些工具）中使用它们，并让所有框架使用相同的模型。 因此，各配置之间的差异反映的是框架本身，而不是工具或模型。 我们在源自沃尔沃 IVI 测试用例的 66 个任务和来自 AMEX 数据集 [ 12 ] 的 56 个开放式任务上，跨四个模型评估这些配置，重复每次运行以测量不稳定性，并访谈了十位从业者：四名开发人员、产品负责人和五名测试人员。 我们提出四个研究问题（RQs）：

sents.en: We address four research questions (RQs):
sents.zh: 我们提出四个研究问题（RQs）：

paragraphs.en: RQ1 (Effectiveness): How effectively do general-purpose harnesses execute intent-driven Android GUI tests compared with an in-house, custom-built harness using the same models?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1（有效性）：与使用相同模型的内部自研测试执行器相比，通用型测试执行器执行意图驱动的 Android GUI 测试的效果如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ2 (Lock-in and robustness to change): How robust is each harness’s effectiveness, without adaptation, to a change of the underlying model or the application under test?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2（锁定性与对变更的鲁棒性）：在不进行调整的情况下，各测试框架的有效性对底层模型或被测应用程序的变更有多强的鲁棒性？

paragraphs.en: RQ3 (Maintenance and cost): How does transitioning from an in-house, custom-built harness to a general-purpose one change the team’s maintenance responsibilities and technical debt, and at what operational cost?
paragraphs.zh: RQ3（维护与成本）：从内部自建的测试工具迁移到通用测试工具，会如何改变团队的维护职责和技术债务，其运营成本又是多少？

paragraphs.en: RQ4 (Stakeholder perspectives): What do the stakeholders of the in-house testing agent value in it, and which of these qualities are preserved or put at risk by moving to a vendor-maintained harness?
paragraphs.zh: RQ4（利益相关者视角）：内部测试智能体的利益相关者看重它的哪些方面，而在转向由供应商维护的测试框架时，这些品质中哪些得以保留，哪些面临风险？

paragraphs.en: This paper makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 本文的主要贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: An industrial comparison that varies only the harness: a production, custom-built harness against two general-purpose harnesses with the same tools and models, on 66 IVI and 56 public-app tasks, covering effectiveness, flakiness, robustness to model and application change, latency, and inference cost (RQ1–RQ3; Sections III and IV ).

paragraphs.en: An interview study with ten practitioners (developers, the product owner, and testers) that identifies ecosystem-induced technical debt and shows how adopting a general-purpose harness redistributes maintenance and control (RQ3, RQ4; Section V ).

paragraphs.en: In this section, we describe the testing system that Volvo has developed and used in production, and the direction we explore for its evolution. We use the term harness for the software around a foundation model that turns it into an agent [ 14 ] : the control loop, the prompts, the context given to the model, and the tools it can use. In a custom-built harness , the harness code defines the workflow: the steps, the routing between agents, and which specialist agent runs when; the model works inside decision slots designed by the developers. In a general-purpose harness , a single generic loop with broad tools lets the model decide what to do next and when to delegate work to subagents; such a harness is adapted to a domain not by changing its loop, but through outer-harness components such as instruction files, MCP servers, and skills. The two kinds differ in where the decisions are made: in the harness code or by the model. Setup A, which we designed and deployed for intent-driven GUI testing at Volvo, is based on a custom-built harness (Section III-A ). Setup B keeps the tools of Setup A but replaces its harness with a general-purpose one, that of Claude Code [ 9 ] or OpenCode [ 10 ] , configured through an instruction template and an MCP [ 11 ] server (Section III-B ). Fig. 1 shows both setups. As the tools are the same, both setups share the state representation S ( i ) S^{(i)} and the action space 𝒜 \mathcal{A} of Section II ; they differ in the policy π \pi that selects the next action and in who maintains the code that implements it (Section III-D ).
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将描述沃尔沃（Volvo）已开发并在生产中使用的测试系统，以及我们为其演进所探索的方向。 我们使用术语「支架」（harness）来指代围绕基础模型、将其转变为智能体的软件 [ 14 ]：包括控制循环、提示词、提供给模型的上下文，以及它可使用的工具。 在定制构建的支架中，支架代码定义了工作流：包括步骤、智能体之间的路由，以及何时运行哪个专家智能体；模型在开发者设计的决策槽位内工作。 在通用支架中，一个带有广泛工具的单一通用循环让模型决定下一步做什么、何时将工作委派给子智能体；这类支架不是通过修改其循环来适配某个领域，而是通过外部支架组件（如指令文件、MCP 服务器和技能）来实现适配。 这两类支架的区别在于决策在哪里做出：是在支架代码中，还是由模型做出。 方案 A 是我们为沃尔沃的意图驱动 GUI 测试所设计和部署的方案，基于定制构建的支架（第 III-A 节）。 方案 B 保留方案 A 的工具，但将其支架替换为通用支架，即 Claude Code [ 9 ] 或 OpenCode [ 10 ] 的支架，通过指令模板和 MCP [ 11 ] 服务器进行配置（第 III-B 节）。 图 1 展示了这两种方案。 由于工具相同，两种方案共享第 II 节中的状态表示 S ( i ) S^{(i)} 和动作空间 𝒜 \mathcal{A}；它们的不同之处在于选择下一个动作的策略 π \pi，以及由谁来维护实现该策略的代码（第 III-D 节）。

paragraphs.en: Step 1: Observe. The harness captures a screenshot and dumps the view hierarchy through device tools (Section III-C ). It simplifies the hierarchy by keeping only nodes that are interactive or display text, and only the attributes needed to identify an element and judge its state: text, content description, resource identifier, bounds, and the flags checked , selected , and enabled . The primary agent is instructed to judge an element’s state from these flags rather than from the screenshot, and to verify it with a tool when the two disagree. The harness does not align visual and structural elements explicitly; it provides both to a multimodal model and relies on the model’s reasoning to align them.
paragraphs.zh: 步骤一：观察。 测试框架（harness）通过设备工具截取屏幕截图并导出视图层级（第 III-C 节）。 它对层级进行简化，只保留可交互或显示文本的节点，并且只保留识别元素和判断其状态所需的属性：文本、内容描述、资源标识符、边界，以及 checked（已勾选）、selected（已选中）和 enabled（已启用）这几个标志位。 主智能体被要求根据这些标志位而非截图来判断元素的状态，并在两者不一致时用工具加以验证。 测试框架不会显式地对齐视觉元素与结构元素；它将两者同时提供给多模态模型，依靠模型的推理来完成对齐。

paragraphs.en: Step 2: Reason. All LLM calls in the harness use zero-shot chain-of-thought prompting [ 17 , 18 ] .

paragraphs.en: Steps 3–4: Validate and act. The harness checks that the selected tool exists and validates its arguments against a schema derived from the tool’s signature. An invalid call is recorded as a failed step; a valid one is invoked as a local Python function of the shared tool layer, and its outcome is recorded in the step log.
paragraphs.zh: 第3–4步：校验并执行。 该框架检查所选工具是否存在，并根据从工具签名派生的模式校验其参数。 无效调用会被记录为失败的步骤；有效调用则作为共享工具层的本地 Python 函数被执行，其结果被记录在步骤日志中。

sents.en: Steps 3–4: Validate and act.
sents.zh: 第3–4步：校验并执行。

sents.en: The harness checks that the selected tool exists and validates its arguments against a schema derived from the tool’s signature.
sents.zh: 该框架检查所选工具是否存在，并根据从工具签名派生的模式校验其参数。

sents.en: An invalid call is recorded as a failed step; a valid one is invoked as a local Python function of the shared tool layer, and its outcome is recorded in the step log.
sents.zh: 无效调用会被记录为失败的步骤；有效调用则作为共享工具层的本地 Python 函数被执行，其结果被记录在步骤日志中。

paragraphs.en: Instructions and history. The harness rebuilds the prompt from scratch at every iteration. Besides the intent and the current observation, i.e., the screenshots before and after the last action, the simplified view hierarchy, and the foreground app and screen, the prompt contains instructions and history. The instructions are fixed: the system prompts, the tool descriptions, and a list of domain hints, such as how long to wait for a pop-up dialog. The history consists of the step log, which records the purpose, tool, arguments, and outcome of every previous action and realizes H ( i ) H^{(i)} , and the checklist. Thus, the harness itself decides what the model sees: earlier steps survive only as entries in the step log, and only the screenshots around the last action are included.
paragraphs.zh: 指令与历史。 执行框架（harness）在每次迭代时从头重建提示。 除了意图和当前观测，即最后一次动作前后的截图、简化的视图层级、以及前台应用和屏幕之外，提示还包含指令与历史。 指令是固定的：系统提示、工具描述，以及一组领域提示，例如等待弹出对话框需要多久。 历史由步骤日志和检查清单组成，步骤日志记录之前每个动作的目的、工具、参数和结果，并实现 H ( i ) H^{(i)}。 因此，由执行框架（harness）自己决定模型能看到什么：较早的步骤仅作为步骤日志中的条目保留下来，并且只有最后一次动作前后的截图会被包含在内。

paragraphs.en: Run records. For every run, the harness produces a report with the screenshot, reasoning, checklist, and action of each step, a log of every prompt and response, and a trajectory that links the primary agent’s run to those of its subagents. These records are the main means of diagnosing whether a failed run reveals an app defect or an agent mistake.
paragraphs.zh: 运行记录。 对于每次运行，测试工具都会生成一份报告，其中包含每个步骤的截图、推理、检查清单和操作，所有提示与响应的日志，以及将主智能体的运行与其子智能体的运行关联起来的轨迹。 这些记录是诊断一次失败的运行究竟是暴露了应用缺陷还是智能体失误的主要手段。

paragraphs.en: We explore Setup B to reduce Setup A’s maintenance burden. We keep the tool layer and device access of Setup A and replace only its primary agent with one built on the harness of Claude Code or OpenCode. Both were built for software development, but their harness is not specific to coding. Setup B adapts it through two outer-harness components: an instruction template and an MCP server through which the primary agent reaches the shared tool layer (Fig. 1 ). The instruction template is identical for every test and shared by both harnesses. Besides a few general rules about our test environment, such as which device to use and that tasks run in installed apps rather than in a browser, it prescribes a general workflow: observe the screen before acting, take element bounds from the hierarchy rather than guessing coordinates, and perform and verify one action at a time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们探索方案 B，以减轻方案 A 的维护负担。 我们保留方案 A 的工具层与设备接入，仅将其主智能体替换为基于 Claude Code 或 OpenCode 框架构建的智能体。 两者都是为软件开发而构建的，但其框架并不局限于编码。 方案 B 通过两个外层框架组件对其进行适配：一个指令模板，以及一个 MCP 服务器——主智能体通过它访问共享工具层（图 1）。 该指令模板在每次测试中完全相同，并由两个框架共享。 除了关于我们测试环境的少量通用规则（例如使用哪台设备，以及任务在已安装的应用中而非浏览器中运行）之外，它还规定了一个通用工作流：在行动前先观察屏幕，从层级结构中获取元素边界而非猜测坐标，并且一次只执行并验证一个操作。

paragraphs.en: Primary agent. The primary agent receives the intent, the tools, and the instructions, and decides by itself how to accomplish the task. Its harness imposes no fixed steps or decision format: at each turn, the model calls the tools it chooses, reads their results, and decides whether to continue, including when to observe the screen again and when the task is complete. The history of the run is the conversation context, which accumulates every tool call and its result and which the harness condenses when it grows long. Both the loop and the context management are maintained by the vendor and adapted to new models as they are released. Like Setup A, Setup B is a multi-agent system: the primary agent can delegate work to subagents of its own, and its intent-based tools are executed by the subagents of the shared tool layer.
paragraphs.zh: 主智能体。 主智能体接收意图、工具和指令，并自行决定如何完成任务。 其运行框架不设定固定步骤或决策格式：在每一轮中，模型调用其选择的工具，读取工具结果，并决定是否继续，包括何时再次观察屏幕以及任务何时完成。 运行的历史记录即对话上下文，它累积每一次工具调用及其结果，并在过长时由运行框架进行压缩。 循环和上下文管理均由厂商维护，并随着新模型的发布进行适配。 与设置 A 一样，设置 B 也是一个多智能体系统：主智能体可以将工作委派给它自己的子智能体，而其基于意图的工具则由共享工具层的子智能体执行。

paragraphs.en: MCP server. An MCP server exposes tools to an agent, each with a name, a natural-language description, and a schema for its arguments. Every action tool returns the simplified hierarchy before and after the action, so the agent can verify its effect without a separate observation call. The server reuses the tools of Setup A but none of its orchestration: which tool to call, when, and when to stop are left to the primary agent.
paragraphs.zh: MCP 服务器。 MCP 服务器向智能体暴露工具，每个工具都有一个名称、一段自然语言描述，以及参数的 schema。 我们的服务器暴露共享工具层（第 III-C 节）。 每个操作工具都会返回操作前后的简化层级，这样智能体无需单独调用观察即可验证其效果。 该服务器复用了 Setup A 的工具，但不复用其编排：调用哪个工具、何时调用以及何时停止，均由主智能体自行决定。

paragraphs.en: Device tools interact with the device without involving an LLM. Two serve observation: one captures a screenshot, and one dumps the view hierarchy as an XML tree, which is simplified as in Setup A; together, they provide V ( i ) V^{(i)} and X ( i ) X^{(i)} . The others act through a single gesture or key event: tap, swipe, drag, set a slider, and press the home or back key. Tools that target an element take its bounding box from the hierarchy and compute the gesture coordinates themselves, e.g., the center of the box for a tap.
paragraphs.zh: 设备工具在不涉及大语言模型（LLM）的情况下与设备交互。 其中两个用于观察：一个截取屏幕截图，另一个将视图层级导出为 XML 树，并按设置 A 中的方式进行简化；二者共同提供 V^{(i)} 和 X^{(i)}。 其余工具通过单次手势或按键事件执行操作：点击、滑动、拖拽、设置滑块，以及按下主屏幕键或返回键。 以元素为目标的工具从层级结构中获取该元素的边界框，并自行计算手势坐标，例如点击时使用边界框的中心点。

paragraphs.en: Subagents perform subtasks that require several interactions or task-specific reasoning: scrolling to an item in a list, entering or clearing text, setting a number picker, and waiting until a condition holds on screen. The primary agent delegates such a subtask with a natural-language intent, such as “scroll to find Developer options and tap it”. Each subagent has its own specialized prompt and LLM context and returns only the final result, which keeps intermediate screens out of the primary agent’s context. Because subagents call an LLM, their behavior, unlike that of device tools, depends on the underlying model.
paragraphs.zh: 子智能体（Subagents）执行需要多轮交互或任务特定推理的子任务：滚动到列表中的某个条目、输入或清除文本、设置数字选择器，以及等待屏幕上的条件成立。 主智能体通过自然语言意图将这类子任务委派出去，例如“滚动查找开发者选项并点按它”。 每个子智能体都有自己专属的提示词（prompt）和 LLM 上下文，并只返回最终结果，这样中间屏幕内容就不会进入主智能体的上下文。 由于子智能体要调用 LLM，它们的行为与设备工具不同，取决于底层模型。

paragraphs.en: Moving from Setup A to Setup B changes who maintains what. In Setup A, Volvo maintains the entire stack, from the primary agent to the device layer. Its control loop, prompts, and construction of the context are designed and tuned together for the models in use. When the backbone model is replaced, the same harness can behave differently [ 20 ] : a new model may decompose an intent differently, declare completion earlier or later, or repeat an action where its predecessor did not. Therefore, keeping the harness effective across model updates requires revising these components, and this effort recurs with every model generation the team adopts. The same holds for new requirements: supporting a new feature or test concept requires the team to develop and extend the harness itself, i.e., its prompts, domain hints, and often its tool set or the routing between its agents.
paragraphs.zh: 从方案 A 切换到方案 B 会改变由谁维护什么。 在方案 A 中，沃尔沃维护整个技术栈，从主智能体到设备层。 其控制回路、提示词以及上下文的构建，都是针对所使用的模型统一设计和调优的。 当骨干模型被更换时，同一套测试框架可能表现不同 [ 20 ]：新模型可能以不同方式分解意图、更早或更晚地宣告完成，或在原模型未重复操作之处重复某个操作。 因此，要在模型更新后保持测试框架的有效性，就需要修订这些组件，而且团队每采用一代新模型，这项工作都会再次出现。 新需求也是如此：支持新功能或新测试概念，需要团队开发和扩展测试框架本身，即其提示词、领域提示，通常还包括其工具集或智能体之间的路由。

paragraphs.en: In Setup B, the agent loop, context management, and tool-calling protocol are maintained by the vendors of the general-purpose harness, while Volvo maintains the MCP server, the instruction template, and the tool layer, including the subagents behind the intent-based tools. When a new model is adopted, the vendor’s harness absorbs most of the adaptation; what remains in-house are the instruction template, the tool descriptions, and the subagents. Likewise, a new requirement is usually addressed by updating the instruction template, and the primary agent adapts its behavior accordingly. Only a new device capability requires adding a tool to the shared tool layer, which the MCP server then exposes without any change to the harness. Because the tool layer is identical, differences between the two setups reflect the policy π \pi and the orchestration, not the observation or actuation code.
paragraphs.zh: 在方案 B 中，智能体循环、上下文管理和工具调用协议由通用框架的供应商维护，而 Volvo 则维护 MCP 服务器、指令模板和工具层，包括基于意图的工具背后的子智能体。 当采用新模型时，供应商的框架承担了大部分适配工作；留在内部的只有指令模板、工具描述和子智能体。 同样，新需求通常通过更新指令模板来解决，主智能体随后相应地调整其行为。 只有新的设备能力才需要在共享工具层中添加工具，MCP 服务器随后会将其暴露出来，而无需对框架做任何改动。 由于工具层完全相同，两种方案之间的差异反映了策略 π \pi 和编排方式的不同，而不是观测或执行代码的差异。

paragraphs.en: This section compares how well the two setups execute test intents and what their execution costs. After describing the setup (Section IV-A ), we report effectiveness, i.e., how often and how reliably each configuration achieves the intent, which answers RQ1 (Section IV-B ), robustness to a change of model or application, which answers RQ2 (Section IV-C ), and efficiency, i.e., the latency, tokens, and inference cost per task, which answers the operational side of RQ3 (Section IV-D ).

paragraphs.en: We report on two benchmarks. The Volvo IVI benchmark consists of 66 tasks on the Infotainment Control Module (ICM) of a Volvo test rig, covering climate control, lights, driving assistance, and system and vehicle settings. Its intents are written as stepwise tests, e.g., “Open the Climate control app; turn the floor air distribution on; turn it off”, and are derived from Volvo’s existing test cases. The AMEX benchmark consists of 56 tasks from the open-source AMEX dataset [ 12 ] , 40 in Google Maps and 16 in Booking.com, executed on Android phones; its intents are single goals, such as searching for a hotel with given dates and filters. We selected these two applications because their tasks could be adapted to dynamic settings similar to our industrial context and complement each other: map search and navigation in Google Maps, and long, multi-step form filling in Booking.com. To evaluate how a run reaches its goal, we also use the milestones of each task, i.e., natural-language descriptions of intermediate UI states.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告两个基准测试。 Volvo IVI 基准测试包含 66 个任务，针对 Volvo 测试台架的信息娱乐控制模块（ICM），涵盖空调控制、灯光、驾驶辅助以及系统和车辆设置。 其意图以分步测试的形式编写，例如“打开空调控制应用；打开地板送风；将其关闭”，并源自 Volvo 现有的测试用例。 AMEX 基准测试包含来自开源 AMEX 数据集 [12] 的 56 个任务，其中 40 个在 Google Maps 中，16 个在 Booking.com 中，在 Android 手机上执行；其意图为单一目标，例如按照给定日期和筛选条件搜索酒店。 我们选择这两个应用，是因为它们的任务可以适配到与我们工业场景类似的动态设置中，且二者互为补充：Google Maps 中的地图搜索与导航，以及 Booking.com 中冗长的多步骤表单填写。 为了评估一次运行如何达成其目标，我们还使用每个任务的里程碑，即对中间 UI 状态的自然语言描述。

paragraphs.en: All configurations use the same tasks, devices, and tool layer. Before each task, we return the device to its home screen and launch the target app. Each configuration is run three times on AMEX and twice on the Volvo rig. Every run is recorded as a trace of tool calls, outputs, and screenshots, which is scored by an LLM judge [ 21 , 22 , 23 ] , GPT-5.6-sol. To check its verdicts across model families, we additionally scored the Booking.com runs with Claude Opus 4.8; the two judges agree on 93.4% of the runs (Cohen’s κ = 0.85 \kappa=0.85 [ 24 ] ) and rank the setups identically. To validate the judge against human judgment, we manually labeled task success for one repetition of the Booking.com benchmark. On the 88% of runs with an unambiguous outcome, GPT-5.6-sol agreed with our manual labels in every case across both setups. The remaining 12% belong to three tasks with debatable success criteria (stopping at a final payment or personal-details screen, or applying valid filters that yielded no matching offers). These ambiguous runs account for all but one of the disagreements between the two judges in this repetition (in the remaining case, our manual check confirmed GPT-5.6-sol), and because GPT-5.6-sol counted all but one of them as failures in both setups, they do not affect the comparison. Runs that end in a timeout or a runtime error count as failures. To check whether differences between setups using the same model are statistically significant, we compare their task success and cost per task using an exact paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test [ 25 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 所有配置均使用相同的任务、设备和工具层。 在每个任务开始前，我们将设备恢复到主屏幕并启动目标应用。 每个配置在 AMEX 上运行三次，在 Volvo 测试台上运行两次。 每次运行都会被记录为包含工具调用、输出和屏幕截图的轨迹，并由 LLM 评委 GPT-5.6-sol 进行评分 [ 21 , 22 , 23 ] 。 为跨模型家族检验其判定结果，我们还使用 Claude Opus 4.8 对 Booking.com 的运行进行了评分；两位评委在 93.4% 的运行上意见一致（Cohen's κ = 0.85 \kappa=0.85 [ 24 ] ），且对各配置的排名完全相同。 为将评委与人类判断进行对照验证，我们对 Booking.com 基准的一次重复运行手动标注了任务成功与否。 在结果明确无歧义的 88% 运行中，GPT-5.6-sol 在两种配置下的所有情形中均与我们的手动标注一致。 其余 12% 属于三个成功标准存在争议的任务（停在最终支付页面或个人详情页面，或应用了有效筛选条件却未得到匹配结果）。 这些有歧义的运行构成了本次重复中两位评委之间除一处之外的全部分歧（在剩下那一例中，我们的人工核查确认了 GPT-5.6-sol 的判断），并且由于 GPT-5.6-sol 在两种配置下将其中的全部（除一处外）都计为失败，因此它们不影响比较结果。 以超时或运行时错误结束的运行计为失败。 为检验使用相同模型的各配置之间的差异是否具有统计显著性，我们使用精确配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验 [ 25 ] 比较它们的任务成功率和每任务成本。

paragraphs.en: We measure effectiveness (RQ1, RQ2) and efficiency (RQ3) per run:
paragraphs.zh: 我们按每次运行测量有效性（RQ1、RQ2）和效率（RQ3）：

paragraphs.en: Task success: whether the run achieved the intent, judged from the full trace, the last three screenshots, and the agent’s reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 任务成功：运行是否达成了意图，根据完整轨迹、最后三张截图以及智能体的推理来判断。

paragraphs.en: Milestone reach: the fraction of milestones reached, judged from the recorded view hierarchies and screenshots.
paragraphs.zh: 里程碑达成率：根据记录的视图层级和截图判断的达成里程碑的比例。

paragraphs.en: Tool correctness: the fraction of action tool calls judged correct, given the view hierarchy before and after each call.
paragraphs.zh: 工具正确性：在给定每次调用前后的视图层级的情况下，被判定为正确的动作工具调用的比例。

paragraphs.en: Fault recovery: among runs with at least one tool call not judged correct, the fraction that still succeeded.
paragraphs.zh: 故障恢复：在至少有一次工具调用未被判定正确的运行中，仍然成功的比例。

paragraphs.en: Flakiness: the fraction of tasks whose success outcome differs across the repeated runs of a configuration [ 26 ] . As the number of runs differs across benchmarks, we compare flakiness only within each benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 不稳定性（Flakiness）：指某个配置在多次重复运行中成功结果不一致的任务所占的比例 [26]。 由于各基准测试的运行次数不同，我们仅在每个基准测试内部比较不稳定性。

sents.en: Flakiness: the fraction of tasks whose success outcome differs across the repeated runs of a configuration [ 26 ] .
sents.zh: 不稳定性（Flakiness）：指某个配置在多次重复运行中成功结果不一致的任务所占的比例 [26]。

sents.en: As the number of runs differs across benchmarks, we compare flakiness only within each benchmark.
sents.zh: 由于各基准测试的运行次数不同，我们仅在每个基准测试内部比较不稳定性。

paragraphs.en: Efficiency: latency, number of tool calls, tokens, and total inference cost in USD per task, including the LLM calls of the subagents.
paragraphs.zh: 效率：包括子智能体的 LLM 调用在内的每项任务的延迟、工具调用次数、token 数量以及以美元计的总推理成本。

paragraphs.en: AMEX benchmark: higher success of Setup B. paragraphs.en: Recovery rather than precision. Setup B does not make fewer incorrect tool calls; on Google Maps, its tool correctness is even lower (88–89% against 93–98%). The difference lies in what follows an incorrect call: Setup B still succeeds in 78–83% of such runs on Google Maps and 27–38% on Booking.com, while Setup A succeeds in 24–53% and 10–18%. We attribute this to the accumulated context of Setup B, which lets the agent notice when an action has no effect or the wrong effect and correct it, whereas Setup A rebuilds its prompt at every step from a compact record of previous actions. On the Volvo IVI benchmark, this pattern does not hold: incorrect calls are rare (tool correctness 93–97%), and fault recovery is low in all configurations. Because the IVI intents prescribe each step, an incorrect action takes the agent off the specified procedure with little room to recover, whereas the open-ended AMEX goals can often still be reached along another path.
paragraphs.zh: 重在恢复而非精准。 设置 B 并没有减少错误的工具调用；在 Google Maps 上，其工具正确性甚至更低（88–89%，对比 93–98%）。 差异在于错误调用之后的处理：在 Google Maps 上，设置 B 在此类运行中仍有 78–83% 成功，在 Booking.com 上为 27–38%，而设置 A 仅为 24–53% 和 10–18%。 我们将此归因于设置 B 所积累的上下文，它使智能体能够察觉某个操作没有生效或产生了错误效果并加以纠正，而设置 A 在每一步都根据先前操作的简要记录重建其提示。 在 Volvo IVI 基准上，这一模式并不成立：错误调用很少见（工具正确性 93–97%），且所有配置下的故障恢复率都很低。 由于 IVI 意图规定了每个步骤，一旦操作出错，智能体就会偏离既定流程，几乎没有恢复余地；而开放式的 AMEX 目标通常仍可通过另一条路径达成。

paragraphs.en: The contrast between the benchmarks is plausibly explained by the form of the intents. The Volvo IVI intents are written as stepwise tests, so planning is largely done by the tester, and the prescribed loop of Setup A suffices. The AMEX intents state only a goal, which requires the agent to plan, explore, and recover and thereby favors the autonomy of Setup B.

Their advantage lies in recovering from mistakes rather than consistently avoiding them.

paragraphs.en: Cost. With the same model, Setup B costs 1.9 to 10.7 times as much per task as Setup A ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 for every comparison). The gap is the largest on the Volvo IVI benchmark, where Claude Code with Sonnet 4.6 costs $4.97 per task against $0.46 for Setup A. Token usage grows by similar factors (2.0 to 12.5). In Setup A, context stays concise because the harness rebuilds the prompt at every step from a compact record of previous actions and the current screen. In Setup B, the conversation context grows with every tool call and its output, including the view hierarchies returned before and after each action, and is sent to the model again at every turn; most of its tokens are therefore re-sent as context. With the same model, OpenCode costs less than or about as much as Claude Code, with similar success on the Volvo IVI benchmark and Google Maps. The production configuration is the cheapest on every benchmark, at $0.13 per task on the Volvo IVI benchmark.

paragraphs.en: We interviewed ten practitioners at Volvo from the three stakeholder groups of Setup A: four developers who build and maintain it (D1–D4), its product owner (PO), and five quality assurance (QA) testers who are actively using it for conducting tests (T1–T5). Three developers had direct experience with both setups, while D1 primarily worked on Setup A and had limited exposure to Setup B. The PO was involved in planning and coordinating the evolution toward Setup B. Since Setup B had not yet been released to testers, their interviews focused on the operational properties they value in Setup A and the requirements a replacement should preserve.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采访了 Volvo 的十位从业者，他们来自 Setup A 的三个利益相关者群体：四位负责构建和维护该系统的开发者（D1–D4）、其产品负责人（PO），以及五位正在积极使用该系统执行测试的质量保证（QA）测试人员（T1–T5）。 三位开发者对两种配置都有直接经验，而 D1 主要从事 Setup A 的工作，对 Setup B 的接触有限。 该产品负责人（PO）参与了向 Setup B 演进的规划与协调工作。 由于 Setup B 尚未发布给测试人员，对他们的采访聚焦于他们在 Setup A 中看重的运行特性，以及替代方案应当保留的需求。

paragraphs.en: We conducted semi-structured interviews [ 27 ] , each lasting 50–60 minutes. To situate both setups, we first walked participants through the evolution of GUI testing at the company, from manual and scripted testing, including AI-assisted scripting, to an agent built on an in-house, custom-built harness (Setup A) and one built on a general-purpose harness (Setup B). We then presented eleven properties tailored to the participant’s role, whose ratings served to structure the discussion rather than as measurements. Developers rated engineering properties, i.e., build effort, maintainability, debuggability, lock-in, integration friction, extensibility, reproducibility, cost, latency, evaluability, and onboarding time, on a scale from 1 (least favorable) to 10 (most favorable). They followed an anchor-and-compare strategy: they first rated each property for Setup A, the anchor, and then for Setup B. Testers rated user-facing properties of Setup A on the same scale, i.e., execution time, coverage, consistency, reproducibility, false positives, false negatives, scenario coherence, verification effort, visibility, control, and onboarding time. The PO did not rate the properties but instead discussed which of the engineering properties matter most for product decisions and what they imply for the choice between the two setups. In the remainder of each interview, we discussed the ratings with the participant, asked for the reasons behind them, and, for developers, for the differences between the two setups. In addition, the team’s manager estimated the share of developer time spent on maintaining and extending Setup A.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开展了半结构化访谈[27]，每次访谈持续50–60分钟。 为了给两种方案提供背景，我们首先向参与者介绍了该公司GUI测试的演进历程：从手工测试和脚本化测试（包括AI辅助编写脚本），到基于公司内部自建测试框架构建的智能体（方案A），以及基于通用测试框架构建的智能体（方案B）。 随后，我们根据参与者的角色展示了十一条特性，对这些特性的评分仅用于组织讨论，而非作为测量指标。 开发者对工程特性进行评分，即构建成本、可维护性、可调试性、锁定效应、集成阻力、可扩展性、可复现性、成本、延迟、可评估性和上手时间，评分范围为1分（最不利）到10分（最有利）。 他们采用了锚定比较策略：首先为作为锚点的方案A对每项特性评分，然后再为方案B评分。 测试人员按相同的评分范围对方案A的用户侧特性进行评分，即执行时间、覆盖率、一致性、可复现性、误报、漏报、场景连贯性、验证工作量、可见性、控制力和上手时间。 产品负责人不对这些特性评分，而是讨论哪些工程特性对产品决策最为重要，以及这些特性对在两种方案之间做出选择有何启示。 在每次访谈的剩余时间里，我们与参与者讨论评分情况，询问评分背后的原因，对开发者还会询问两种方案之间的差异。 此外，团队的经理估算并给出了开发和维护、扩展方案A所占用的开发者时间比例。

paragraphs.en: We report four core findings. The first two explain why maintaining the in-house harness became harder to justify and how adopting a general-purpose harness changes engineering responsibilities (RQ3). The third examines the resulting trade-offs in engineering effort, execution cost, runtime control, and latency (RQ3, RQ4). The fourth identifies what must be preserved for autonomous testing to remain trustworthy (RQ4). Each finding ends with an implication for teams in comparable industrial settings; as these findings are grounded in one specific industrial case, we present them as lessons rather than as general best practices.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了四项核心发现。 前两项解释了为什么维护自研测试框架变得越来越难以自圆其说，以及采用通用测试框架如何改变了工程职责（RQ3）。 第三项考察了由此产生的在工程投入、执行成本、运行时控制和延迟方面的权衡（RQ3、RQ4）。 第四项指出了要让自主测试保持可信，必须保留哪些要素（RQ4）。 每项发现都以对处于类似工业环境的团队的启示作结；由于这些发现基于某一个特定的工业案例，我们将其作为经验教训而非通用最佳实践来呈现。

paragraphs.en: F1: Debt emerged from a shifting ecosystem, not a decaying system. The ecosystem around Setup A changed in three ways. First, model changes could require renewed validation and adjustments to prompts and agent behavior, although the team sometimes deferred upgrades to limit this burden (Section III-D ). D1 described the team’s development capacity as insufficient to keep pace with advances in LLMs and agent harnesses. Testers noticed the side effects: after one update, the agent began improperly judging media playback states based on the view hierarchy, failing previously passing tasks (T5). Second, requirements grew beyond the original design, such as operating several devices in one test (D3) and connecting adjacent validation tasks, such as audio, signals, and other displays (PO). Some of these requests emerged because an AI-based platform already existed, not because they served its original purpose of GUI testing (PO). Third, and most critically, general-purpose harnesses matured. D3 explained that Setup A was built because no capable general-purpose harness existed; once such harnesses appeared, the team was maintaining generic agent infrastructure that vendors now maintain for everyone. D2 and the PO drew the same conclusion: if a vendor-maintained harness performs comparably, maintaining an equivalent in-house is hard to justify. The interviews did not identify deterioration of the original architecture as the primary motivation for considering replacement. Indeed, Setup A matches Setup B in task success on the IVI benchmark (Section IV-B ). Instead, participants emphasized the growing maintenance burden and the emergence of externally maintained alternatives. Thus, the debt lies not in the system’s effectiveness, but in the increasing opportunity cost of maintaining its in-house orchestration. We characterize this as ecosystem-induced technical debt : a previously justified architecture becomes increasingly costly to maintain relative to external alternatives as the surrounding technological ecosystem matures.
paragraphs.zh: F1：债务源于生态系统的变迁，而非系统的腐化。 围绕方案A的生态系统发生了三方面的变化。 首先，模型的变更可能需要重新验证，并调整提示词和智能体行为，尽管团队有时会推迟升级以限制这一负担（第III-D节）。 D1描述该团队的研发能力不足以跟上大语言模型和智能体框架的进展。 测试人员注意到了这些副作用：在某次更新之后，智能体开始基于视图层次结构不当判断媒体播放状态，导致此前通过的任务失败（T5）。 其次，需求超出了最初的设计，例如在一次测试中操作多台设备（D3），以及连接相邻的验证任务，如音频、信号和其他显示（PO）。 其中一些需求之所以出现，是因为已经存在一个基于AI的平台，而不是因为它们服务于该平台最初进行GUI测试的目的（PO）。 第三，也是最关键的一点，通用框架成熟了。 D3解释说，之所以构建方案A，是因为当时不存在能力足够的通用框架；一旦这类框架出现，团队维护的通用智能体基础设施就变成了厂商如今为所有人维护的东西。 D2和PO得出了相同的结论：如果厂商维护的框架性能相当，维护一个等效的自研框架就难以自圆其说。 访谈并未发现原始架构的退化是考虑替换的主要动机。 事实上，在IVI基准上，方案A的任务成功率与方案B相当（第IV-B节）。 相反，参与者强调的是不断增长的维护负担以及外部维护的替代方案的出现。 因此，债务不在于系统的有效性，而在于维护其自研编排的机会成本不断上升。 我们将此称为生态诱导的技术债务：随着周边技术生态系统的成熟，一个原本合理有据的架构相对于外部替代方案而言，维护成本变得越来越高。

sents.en: F1: Debt emerged from a shifting ecosystem, not a decaying system.
sents.zh: F1：债务源于生态系统的变迁，而非系统的腐化。

sents.en: The ecosystem around Setup A changed in three ways.
sents.zh: 围绕方案A的生态系统发生了三方面的变化。

sents.en: First, model changes could require renewed validation and adjustments to prompts and agent behavior, although the team sometimes deferred upgrades to limit this burden (Section III-D ).
sents.zh: 首先，模型的变更可能需要重新验证，并调整提示词和智能体行为，尽管团队有时会推迟升级以限制这一负担（第III-D节）。

sents.en: D1 described the team’s development capacity as insufficient to keep pace with advances in LLMs and agent harnesses.
sents.zh: D1描述该团队的研发能力不足以跟上大语言模型和智能体框架的进展。

sents.en: Testers noticed the side effects: after one update, the agent began improperly judging media playback states based on the view hierarchy, failing previously passing tasks (T5).
sents.zh: 测试人员注意到了这些副作用：在某次更新之后，智能体开始基于视图层次结构不当判断媒体播放状态，导致此前通过的任务失败（T5）。

sents.en: Second, requirements grew beyond the original design, such as operating several devices in one test (D3) and connecting adjacent validation tasks, such as audio, signals, and other displays (PO).
sents.zh: 其次，需求超出了最初的设计，例如在一次测试中操作多台设备（D3），以及连接相邻的验证任务，如音频、信号和其他显示（PO）。

sents.en: Some of these requests emerged because an AI-based platform already existed, not because they served its original purpose of GUI testing (PO).
sents.zh: 其中一些需求之所以出现，是因为已经存在一个基于AI的平台，而不是因为它们服务于该平台最初进行GUI测试的目的（PO）。

sents.en: Third, and most critically, general-purpose harnesses matured.
sents.zh: 第三，也是最关键的一点，通用框架成熟了。

sents.en: D3 explained that Setup A was built because no capable general-purpose harness existed; once such harnesses appeared, the team was maintaining generic agent infrastructure that vendors now maintain for everyone.
sents.zh: D3解释说，之所以构建方案A，是因为当时不存在能力足够的通用框架；一旦这类框架出现，团队维护的通用智能体基础设施就变成了厂商如今为所有人维护的东西。

sents.en: D2 and the PO drew the same conclusion: if a vendor-maintained harness performs comparably, maintaining an equivalent in-house is hard to justify.
sents.zh: D2和PO得出了相同的结论：如果厂商维护的框架性能相当，维护一个等效的自研框架就难以自圆其说。

sents.en: The interviews did not identify deterioration of the original architecture as the primary motivation for considering replacement.
sents.zh: 访谈并未发现原始架构的退化是考虑替换的主要动机。

sents.en: Indeed, Setup A matches Setup B in task success on the IVI benchmark (Section IV-B ).
sents.zh: 事实上，在IVI基准上，方案A的任务成功率与方案B相当（第IV-B节）。

sents.en: Instead, participants emphasized the growing maintenance burden and the emergence of externally maintained alternatives.
sents.zh: 相反，参与者强调的是不断增长的维护负担以及外部维护的替代方案的出现。

sents.en: Thus, the debt lies not in the system’s effectiveness, but in the increasing opportunity cost of maintaining its in-house orchestration.
sents.zh: 因此，债务不在于系统的有效性，而在于维护其自研编排的机会成本不断上升。

sents.en: We characterize this as ecosystem-induced technical debt : a previously justified architecture becomes increasingly costly to maintain relative to external alternatives as the surrounding technological ecosystem matures.
sents.zh: 我们将此称为生态诱导的技术债务：随着周边技术生态系统的成熟，一个原本合理有据的架构相对于外部替代方案而言，维护成本变得越来越高。

paragraphs.en: Implication. Revisit the build-versus-adopt decision whenever a new model generation or a mature general-purpose harness becomes available, weighing the cost of keeping the in-house harness current against adopting the external one.
paragraphs.zh: 启示。 每当出现新一代模型或成熟通用的框架（harness）时，都应重新审视自建还是采用外部方案的决策，权衡维护自研框架更新的成本与采用外部框架的成本。

sents.en: Implication.
sents.zh: 启示。

sents.en: Revisit the build-versus-adopt decision whenever a new model generation or a mature general-purpose harness becomes available, weighing the cost of keeping the in-house harness current against adopting the external one.
sents.zh: 每当出现新一代模型或成熟通用的框架（harness）时，都应重新审视自建还是采用外部方案的决策，权衡维护自研框架更新的成本与采用外部框架的成本。

paragraphs.en: F2: External harnesses shift maintenance from orchestration to integration. In Setup A, extending the harness is engineering work. D3 explained that adding even a second way to tap an element, by coordinates or by text, expands the agent’s action choices and may affect existing behavior, so every extension requires re-evaluation; larger requirements, such as operating several devices, conflict with assumptions built into the loop. The developers who had worked with both setups (D2–D4) found Setup B easier to build, maintain, and extend, as new capabilities are added as tools or instructions. The remaining effort concentrates on the interface: D2 identified the design of clear tool descriptions and parameters as an important integration challenge, since the generic agent must select and invoke the appropriate tools. The PO placed this change in a longer shift of maintenance ownership. With scripted tests, testers repaired their own scripts. With Setup A, testers report agent failures, the PO prioritizes them, and the AI team fixes the harness. As a result, Setup A exchanged distributed script maintenance for centralized agent maintenance, which competes with feature requests for the team’s capacity. With Setup B, the generic part of this maintenance moves to the vendor, while the team retains testing-specific instructions, tools, and integration logic.
paragraphs.zh: F2：外部测试框架将维护工作从编排转移到了集成。 在方案 A 中，扩展测试框架是一项工程工作。 D3 解释说，即使只是增加第二种定位元素的方式（通过坐标或文本），也会扩大智能体的动作选择范围，并可能影响现有行为，因此每次扩展都需要重新评估；更大的需求（例如操作多台设备）则与循环中内置的假设相冲突。 两种方案都用过的开发者（D2–D4）认为方案 B 更易于构建、维护和扩展，因为新能力是以工具或指令的形式添加的。 剩余的工作集中在接口上：D2 指出，设计清晰的工具描述和参数是一项重要的集成挑战，因为通用智能体必须选择并调用合适的工具。 产品负责人将这一变化置于维护责任更长期转移的背景之中。 使用脚本化测试时，测试人员自行修复自己的脚本。 使用方案 A 时，测试人员报告智能体故障，产品负责人确定其优先级，AI 团队负责修复测试框架。 因此，方案 A 把分布式的脚本维护换成了集中式的智能体维护，而这种维护会与功能需求争夺团队的产能。 使用方案 B 时，这部分维护的通用部分转移给了供应商，而团队则保留测试专用的指令、工具和集成逻辑。

sents.zh: F2：外部测试框架将维护工作从编排转移到了集成。

When adopting a vendor-maintained harness, budget for the integration work that remains: the instruction template, the tool descriptions, and the tools.
paragraphs.zh: 启示。 在 QA 团队和平台团队两个层面衡量维护成本，而不仅仅是测试人员节省下来的脚本维护工作。 在采用厂商维护的测试框架时，要为剩余的集成工作预留预算：指令模板、工具描述以及工具本身。

paragraphs.en: F3: Outsourcing orchestration reduces engineering effort but introduces runtime trade-offs. While Setup B reduces the internal orchestration effort discussed in F2, it introduces trade-offs in runtime control and execution cost. In Setup A, the team decides what enters the primary agent’s context, what is removed, and how much history is retained (Section III-A ). In Setup B, several of these decisions are delegated to the external harness. D3 identified context management as the main capability lost in the transition, arguing that the external harness’s context-management behavior was not sufficiently tailored to testing. D2 highlighted context compaction during long tasks, whose timing and effects the team cannot directly control; D4 noted that the external harness has greater freedom over its internal execution.
paragraphs.zh: F3：将编排外包可减少工程工作量，但会引入运行时的权衡。 虽然设置 B 减少了 F2 中讨论的内部编排工作量，但它在运行时控制和执行成本方面引入了权衡。 在设置 A 中，团队决定哪些内容进入主智能体的上下文、哪些内容被移除，以及保留多少历史记录（第 III-A 节）。 在设置 B 中，这些决策中有若干项被委托给外部测试框架。 D3 将上下文管理识别为在过渡过程中丧失的主要能力，认为外部测试框架的上下文管控行为没有充分针对测试进行调适。 D2 强调了长任务期间的上下文压缩，其时机与效果是团队无法直接控制的；D4 则指出外部测试框架对其内部执行拥有更大的自由度。

However, it incurred higher inference costs (Section IV-D ), which developers partly attributed to the larger execution histories repeatedly included in model calls. Consistent with these measurements, developers rated cost as the property with the largest disadvantage for Setup B. Thus, reducing internal engineering effort may increase the inference expenditure incurred during repeated regression testing.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管运行时控制有所减少，方案 B 在我们的基准测试中仍取得了相当甚至更高的总体任务成功率（第 IV-B 节）。 然而，它带来了更高的推理成本（第 IV-D 节），开发者部分将其归因于模型调用中反复包含的更大规模的执行历史。 与这些测量结果一致，开发者将成本评为方案 B 劣势最大的属性。 因此，减少内部工程投入可能会增加在反复回归测试过程中产生的推理开销。

paragraphs.en: Execution latency presents a different trade-off. With the same model, Setup B was at most 11% faster on the IVI benchmark (Section IV-D ), yet execution time remained a major concern among testers (T2). T1 estimated that approximately 60 tests required five hours, consistent in magnitude with the benchmark’s mean latency of 297 s per task (Table II ), although the workloads are not directly equivalent. The PO further emphasized that long-running suites occupy scarce test rigs and delay QA feedback. Nevertheless, testers valued the ability to run tests unattended overnight (T3). Consequently, reducing harness maintenance does not by itself eliminate the operational bottleneck of long-running agentic tests.
paragraphs.zh: 执行延迟呈现出另一种权衡。 使用相同模型时，Setup B 在 IVI 基准测试（第 IV-D 节）中最多快 11%，但执行时间仍是测试人员的主要顾虑（T2）。 T1 估计约 60 个测试需要五个小时，与基准测试中每项任务平均 297 秒的延迟在数量级上一致（表 II），尽管两者工作负载并不完全等同。 产品负责人进一步强调，长时间运行的测试套件会占用稀缺的测试设备，并延误 QA 反馈。 尽管如此，测试人员仍然看重能够无人值守地通宵运行测试的能力（T3）。 因此，减少测试框架的维护工作本身并不能消除长时间运行的智能体测试带来的运维瓶颈。

Benchmark representative workloads and track suite duration per rig as a capacity metric; changing the harness alone should not be assumed to resolve execution-time constraints.

paragraphs.en: RQ3 findings (maintenance, qualitative): In our case, maintaining the in-house harness became harder to justify as external harnesses matured, creating what we characterize as ecosystem-induced technical debt. paragraphs.en: F4: Test fidelity requires bounded autonomy and execution visibility. Testers ranked visibility as Setup A’s strongest property. Autonomous execution has not eliminated human verification: testers described inspecting screenshots, logs, and execution traces to validate failures, sometimes reproducing the workflow manually (T1, T3, T4). Testers also reported behavioral changes following agent updates: after a model update, T5 observed that when an application crash prevented the intended workflow, the agent continued attempting the task instead of recognizing and reporting the blocking failure. Such behavior risks obscuring genuine application defects. Together, the accounts of T1, T3, T4, and T5 suggest that testers value autonomous navigation and adaptation but expect the agent to remain faithful to the specified test scenario.
paragraphs.zh: F4：测试保真度要求有界自主性和执行可见性。 测试人员将可见性评为设置 A 最突出的特性。 自主执行并未消除人工验证：测试人员描述了通过检查截图、日志和执行轨迹来验证失败情况，有时还会手动重现该工作流（T1、T3、T4）。 测试人员还报告了智能体更新后的行为变化：在一次模型更新后，T5 观察到，当应用程序崩溃阻止了预期工作流时，智能体会继续尝试执行任务，而不是识别并报告这一阻塞性失败。 这种行为有可能掩盖真正的应用程序缺陷。 综合 T1、T3、T4 和 T5 的反馈来看，测试人员重视自主导航与适应能力，但期望智能体始终忠实于指定的测试场景。

paragraphs.en: Implication. The goal of a testing agent is to verify the specified path, not only to reach the final state. Regardless of the harness, teams should instruct or constrain the agent to stop and report when the app under test fails instead of working around the failure.

paragraphs.en: RQ4 findings: Developers prioritize maintainability, while testers need visible execution and faithful adherence to test scenarios. The autonomy that helps an agent complete open-ended tasks can undermine regression testing when recovery bypasses a defect. Therefore, a replacement must preserve testers’ ability to verify both the outcome and the path taken to reach it.
paragraphs.zh: RQ4 的发现：开发者优先考虑可维护性，而测试人员需要可见的执行过程以及对测试场景的忠实遵循。 帮助智能体完成开放式任务的自主性，在恢复过程绕过缺陷时可能会损害回归测试。 因此，替代方案必须保留测试人员验证结果以及验证达成该结果所走路径的能力。

paragraphs.en: Our results suggest that choosing between a custom-built and a general-purpose harness is less a question of which one performs better than of which costs, risks, and responsibilities an organization prefers to carry. We discuss four themes that cut across our quantitative and qualitative results and conclude each with a lesson for practitioners.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果表明，在自研框架与通用框架之间做选择，与其说是哪一种性能更好的问题，不如说是一个组织更愿意承担哪些成本、风险与责任的问题。 我们讨论了贯穿定量与定性结果的四个主题，并在每个主题末尾给出一条面向从业者的经验教训。

paragraphs.en: Rethinking technical debt in the LLM era. Technical debt is usually attributed to expedient decisions within a system [ 30 ] , and machine learning systems are known to accumulate debt in the infrastructure around the model [ 31 ] . Our case points to a further mechanism. Setup A did not deteriorate: its code did not degrade, and it still matches Setup B on the IVI benchmark (Section IV-B ). Instead, its value declined relative to the alternatives as new model generations, new requirements, and mature general-purpose harnesses emerged (F1). Because models evolve much faster than conventional dependencies, such external changes can quickly turn a sound investment into debt. Adopting a general-purpose harness does not retire this debt but changes its form. The vendor now decides when the loop, the context management, and the compaction policy change, and such updates can alter the agent’s behavior without any change on the team’s side (F3). The MCP server, the instruction template, and the tool descriptions remain in-house and need upkeep as models and tools evolve (F2). Therefore, the build-versus-adopt decision is not made once: it shifts from maintaining an agent runtime to monitoring an external dependency. Lesson: Treat an in-house agent harness as a depreciating asset: keep domain knowledge, i.e., tools, instructions, and test intents, separable from the orchestration, so that the orchestration can be replaced once it no longer pays off.
paragraphs.zh: 重新思考大语言模型时代的技术债。 技术债通常归因于系统内的权宜决策 [ 30 ]，而众所周知，机器学习系统会在模型周边的基础设施中累积债务 [ 31 ]。 我们的案例指出了另一种机制。 方案 A 并没有恶化：其代码没有退化，并且在 IVI 基准上仍与方案 B 表现相当（第 IV-B 节）。 相反，随着新一代模型、新需求以及成熟通用的 harness 的出现，其价值相对于其他替代方案下降了（F1）。 由于模型演化的速度远快于传统依赖，这类外部变化可能迅速使一笔合理的投资变成债务。 采用通用的 harness 并不会消除这笔债务，只是改变了其形式。 供应商现在决定循环、上下文管理和压缩策略何时发生变化，此类更新可能在团队这边毫无改动的情况下改变智能体的行为（F3）。 MCP 服务器、指令模板和工具描述仍留在内部，需要随着模型和工具的演化进行维护（F2）。 因此，自建还是采用的决策并非一次性做出：它从维护一个智能体运行时转变为监控一项外部依赖。 经验教训：将内部智能体 harness 视为一项会贬值的资产：保持领域知识，即工具、指令和测试意图，与编排逻辑可分离，以便在编排不再划算时可以将其替换。

paragraphs.en: Trading engineering effort for inference cost. General-purpose harnesses remove what developers described as Setup A’s most demanding maintenance work: retuning the loop, prompts, and context construction for each model generation. New requirements are mostly handled through instructions and tools rather than loop changes (Section III-D , F2). However, inference costs are 1.9–10.7 times as high per task with the same model (2.6–10.7 on the IVI benchmark). Therefore, adoption shifts a largely fixed engineering burden, incurred when models or requirements change, to a variable operational expense paid on every run. In our case, engineering effort falls from about 0.5 full-time equivalents (FTE) across four developers for Setup A to 0.1 FTE for Setup B’s tools and instructions. At 60 IVI tasks per working night, Setup B’s additional inference cost over Setup A’s production configuration equals 0.06–0.39 FTE, below the 0.4 FTE saved. Total monthly engineering and inference costs are therefore 3–66% lower, with OpenCode yielding the largest savings and Claude Code the smallest. The preferable burden depends on the workload. Execution costs may dominate for large, frequently run stepwise regression suites, where both setups perform comparably. Open-ended tasks or limited developer capacity, as in our case (F1), may justify offloading orchestration. Compact tool outputs can reduce Setup B’s costs because most tokens are re-sent context; OpenCode already costs less than Claude Code at similar success. Scope creep favors the general-purpose harness. Once an agent works, stakeholders ask it to do more, such as operating several devices or validating audio and signals (F1). A custom-built harness must change its agent loop for such requests, whereas a general-purpose one can often absorb them through an updated instruction template (F2). Still, no harness excels at everything: teams must decide which properties matter most, e.g., success, cost, or control, and accept trade-offs in the others. Lesson: Decide per test category which burden to carry, engineering effort or inference cost, and scope the agent deliberately, particularly when you are building a custom harness.
paragraphs.zh: 以工程投入换取推理成本。 通用型执行框架（harness）消除了开发者所描述的设置 A 中最繁重的维护工作：为每一代模型重新调整循环、提示词和上下文构建。 新需求大多通过指令和工具来处理，而无需改动循环（第 III-D 节，F2）。 然而，在使用相同模型的情况下，每个任务的推理成本高出 1.9–10.7 倍（在 IVI 基准上为 2.6–10.7 倍）。 因此，采用这种方式把一种主要由模型或需求变更引发的大致固定的工程负担，转变为每次运行都要支付的变动运营开支。 在我们的案例中，工程投入从设置 A 中四位开发者共约 0.5 全职等效人力（FTE）降至设置 B 的工具和指令所需的 0.1 FTE。 按每个工作日晚间 60 个 IVI 任务计算，设置 B 相对设置 A 生产配置的额外推理成本相当于 0.06–0.39 FTE，低于节省下来的 0.4 FTE。 因此，每月的工程与推理总成本降低了 3–66%，其中 OpenCode 带来的节省最大，Claude Code 最小。 何种负担更可取取决于工作负载。 对于规模大且频繁运行的分步回归测试套件，两种设置的表现相当，此时执行成本可能占主导。 开放式任务或开发者人力有限的情况，如我们的案例（F1），可能值得将编排工作外包出去。 精简工具输出可以降低设置 B 的成本，因为大部分 token 是重复发送的上下文；在成功率相近的情况下，OpenCode 的成本已经低于 Claude Code。 范围蔓延（scope creep）有利于通用型执行框架。 一旦某个智能体跑通了，利益相关者就会要求它做更多事情，例如操作多台设备或验证音频与信号（F1）。 自建的执行框架必须为这类请求改动其智能体循环，而通用型框架通常可以通过更新指令模板来吸纳这些需求（F2）。 尽管如此，没有任何一个执行框架在所有方面都出色：团队必须决定哪些属性最重要，例如成功率、成本或控制力，并接受其他方面的取舍。 经验教训：按测试类别决定承担哪种负担——工程投入还是推理成本——并审慎地界定智能体的范围，尤其是在构建自定义执行框架时。

paragraphs.en: Flexible intents, stable verdicts. Most IVI intents are written as numbered steps, a style that testers likely carry over from scripted testing: specifying each step ensures that the agent follows the intended path. Other stakeholders prefer goal-level intents and leave the planning to the agent, which is where the general-purpose harnesses performed best (Section IV-B ). Harnesses should accommodate this full range, including high-level goals with mandatory steps, without imposing one style. However, higher success on open-ended tasks did not imply greater stability on structured tests. On the IVI benchmark, inconsistent outcomes occurred on 2–3% of tasks with Setup A and 5–9% with Setup B, although Setup B was more stable on Google Maps. Regression testing requires consistent verdicts across runs. Testers already verify failures manually (F4), so additional inconsistency increases their workload; even a small stability loss on structured tests may outweigh greater success on open-ended tasks. Lesson: With natural-language intents, users expect an agent to handle both stepwise procedures and open-ended, high-level goals. Evaluate a candidate harness on both styles and, beyond its success rate, on its stability, i.e., whether repeated runs of the same test yield the same verdict.

paragraphs.en: Keeping visibility and control when outsourcing the loop. Moving to a general-purpose harness outsources the loop but not the responsibility for test results. Testers value seeing what the agent did and need it to stay within the test scenario (F4). The recovery advantage of Setup B (Section IV-B ) concerns the agent’s own incorrect actions rather than failures of the app under test, and it stays on the intended path: notably, on the AMEX benchmark, recovered runs reached as many milestones as runs without an incorrect call. With a vendor-maintained harness, both must be built deliberately on top of it: run records that the team controls, instructions that require stopping and reporting when the app under test fails, and verdicts that flag workarounds. A further mechanism is an experience library : a curated, team-owned collection of successful and failed trajectories from past tasks, including their intermediate steps [ 32 , 33 ] . Supplied to the agent as in-context examples [ 34 ] , successful trajectories demonstrate the expected path, while annotated failed runs let the agent learn from mistakes in context [ 35 ] . Beyond potentially stabilizing behavior and reducing latency and cost on known tasks, such a library makes the expected behavior visible and reviewable for testers. As current models are optimized for instruction following, encoding instructions as examples is also more likely to survive model and harness updates than prompts tuned to a specific model. Such a library pays off mainly in narrow domains with recurring tasks, such as a regression suite for a fixed set of applications, rather than across the diverse applications and intents of our evaluation. We see this as a promising direction for keeping domain knowledge in-house while the orchestration is outsourced. Lesson: Outsourcing the loop does not outsource trust: give testers what they need to verify the agent, such as team-controlled run records and reviewable examples of expected and failed behavior.

paragraphs.en: Our mixed-methods study combines quantitative benchmarking and qualitative practitioner interviews at Volvo Group to examine the adoption of general-purpose agent harnesses. These harnesses perform better on open-ended tasks and reduce orchestration work. For nightly IVI regression, engineering savings outweigh higher inference costs, lowering total monthly costs by 3–66%, at the price of less control over what the model receives. The custom-built harness remains competitive and more consistent on stepwise IVI tests; it became debt not by deteriorating but because its ecosystem matured, which we term ecosystem-induced technical debt . For workloads like ours, adopting is the better choice; keeping a custom harness pays off mainly where consistency on stepwise tests or control over the model’s context matters more than maintenance effort. Teams should keep domain tools and test knowledge separate from the orchestration, so that it can be replaced, and must ensure, whatever the harness, that testers can see what the agent did and that it stays within the test scenario. Future work will explore team-owned libraries of verified execution trajectories to make agent behavior more consistent and reduce token use.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的混合方法研究结合了定量基准测试与沃尔沃集团（Volvo Group）从业者定性访谈，以考察通用智能体框架的采用情况。 这些框架在开放式任务上表现更好，并减少了编排工作。 对于夜间 IVI 回归测试而言，工程节省超过了更高的推理成本，使每月总成本降低 3–66%，代价是对模型接收内容的控制减少。 自研框架在分步式 IVI 测试上仍具竞争力且更加稳定；它之所以成为债务，并非因为质量退化，而是因为其生态系统的成熟，我们将其称为生态诱导技术债务。 对于类似我们的工作负载，采用现成框架是更好的选择；保留自研框架主要在以下情况才有回报：分步测试上的一致性或对模型上下文的控制比维护成本更重要。 团队应将领域工具和测试知识与编排逻辑分开存放，以便编排逻辑可以被替换，并且无论使用何种框架，都必须确保测试人员能够看到智能体做了什么，并确保其始终停留在测试场景之内。 未来的工作将探索由团队拥有的、经过验证的执行轨迹库，以使智能体行为更加一致并减少 token 消耗。
